comment: BUILD.GATE.3 — last-known-synced state of deployed edge functions. ezbr_sha256 comes from `npx supabase functions list`; it hashes the deployed bundle, so it cannot be recomputed from source — it changes on every deploy. `npm run drift` compares live values against this file: a mismatch means someone deployed (e.g. via dashboard) since the repo was last synced, i.e. the repo copy may be stale. After any intentional deploy or repo re-sync, update the sha here in the same commit.
pendingDeployComment: A function that is written and committed but NOT yet deployed goes here, not in `functions` below: the drift gate fails a ledgered function that is not live, and it equally fails a live function that is not ledgered. Deploying is a supervised step — deploy, read its ezbr_sha256 from `npx supabase functions list`, move the slug into `functions` in the SAME commit, then `npm run drift` must go green. (Emptied 2026-08-03 by UNFURL.DEPLOY.1, which walked `unfurl` through exactly that path.)

youtube-transcript.verifiedInSync: 2026-09-25 — BLOG.2b redeploy: captions via YouTube's player API (Android client) instead of the watch page; sha read from `npx supabase functions list` immediately after the deploy, ledgered in the SAME commit. Live verify_jwt=true plus the has_role('admin') re-check. Deployed test as admin: 500 'YouTube player request failed (403)' for both a Spanish (AhkB-Q5K4ZQ) and an English (iG9CE55wbtY) video — YouTube refuses the function's egress, while the same code returns 5,984 / 17,574 characters from a home connection. The Studio hides the input (YOUTUBE_INPUT_ENABLED=false); the function stays deployed.
